texts.en: The Covenant has provided in Article 9 the constitution of a military, naval and air Commission, charged with advising on the execution of the dispositions of Articles 1 and 8, and in a general way to advise on military, naval and air questions. The Council of the League at its session in Rome laid down the terms of reference for this Commission, which can now get to work.
